body:
Dear Friend,
We need your products urgently. Payment will be made by USDT or Bitcoin only.
Please send invoice immediately and use a private account for faster settlement.
Waiting for your urgent reply.
reply:
Dear [Recipient],

Thank you for your urgent inquiry regarding our products. However, to proceed securely, I must ask you to confirm your country or location. Given the payment methods suggested, we are cautious and want to ensure proper verification.

Once I have your location, I will promptly address your request for an invoice.

Best,
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
